other_exits: Basket take-profit: closes all grid orders when total floating profit of all open orders in the grid reaches a configurable threshold in currency units
Average price take-profit: TP calculated from weighted average entry price of all grid positions

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Each subsequent grid level increases lot size by a multiplier (martingale lot escalation: Lot * multiplier^level)

custom_logic_notes: Classic SETKA (grid) EA: places initial order, then sets a grid of pending limit orders at fixed pip intervals in the losing direction. Each grid level increases lot size by a multiplier (martingale scaling). Exit is basket-based — all positions close when combined floating profit hits a target. No individual SL/TP per order. Heavy margin usage as grid expands. Strategy is inherently martingale and will eventually margin-call on strong trends without intervention. Magic number used to identify grid belongs to this EA instance.
python_conversion_notes: Grid/martingale strategy is extremely difficult to faithfully replicate in Python backtest. Requires tick-level data at minimum. Pending order management (placing/cancelling/modifying grid of limit orders) needs careful state tracking. Margin calculation must mirror MT5's margin model exactly. Basket profit calculation across variable-lot positions is straightforward but the grid expansion logic with lot multiplication is complex. Recommend mt5_only classification — a Python conversion would only capture approximate behavior, not the exact broker-dependent execution dynamics this strategy relies on.
